title: Add MissionSpec, ControlAck, and ControlRecord invariant verifiers in susi-harness
goal: Add MissionSpec::verify_spec_invariants and ControlAck::verify_ack_invariants in crates/susi-harness/src/api.rs and ControlRecord::verify_record_invariants in crates/susi-harness/src/control.rs with unit tests.
acceptance: MissionSpec::verify_spec_invariants, ControlAck::verify_ack_invariants, and ControlRecord::verify_record_invariants validate structural and semantic invariants of operator control commands and acknowledgements.
